## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Qīng-period Tibetan-Esoteric verse-praise of Śākyamuni Buddha translated by **Samten Targye** ([薩穆丹達爾吉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%96%A9%E7%A9%86%E4%B8%B9%E9%81%94%E7%88%BE%E5%90%89)). The text is the Tibetan-Esoteric counterpart to the Táng/Sòng-period anonymous *Shìjiāmóunī fó zàn* ([KR6j0113](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0113)).

**Abstract**

The *Shìjiā fó zàn* presents a Tibetan-canonical *stotra* (verse-praise) of Śākyamuni in Chinese translation. The text is short and devotional — a standard form of Tibetan-Buddhist liturgical practice adapted for Qīng-court Chinese-language use. The translation dates from Samten Targye's Qiánlóng to early Jiāqìng career (1736–1820).
